thread:
jess-customer: Hey, we've been seeing periodic p50 spikes on our /v1/generate calls since yesterday. Errors: some 500s, some timeouts. Request IDs: 9f7a3c2b, 9f7a3c98, 9f7a3d11. High concurrency test was at 120 rps with 5k avg tokens.

alex.support: Sorry about that — can you share a curl repro and the longest failing request ID? Also which model and region?

jess-customer: Model: redwood/fast-qa-v1, region: us-east. Longest fail: 9f7a3d11. Curl: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa-v1","input":"<prompt>...","max_tokens":200}'
```

mira.eng: Thanks. Can you include a short promptset (3 prompts) and the concurrency profile? We want to reproduce in the repro-pack.

jess-customer: Promptset: 1) "Summarize invoice 123" (avg 80 tokens), 2) "Extract fields from receipt" (avg 230 tokens), 3) "Short code review" (avg 150 tokens). Concurrency profile: ramp 0->120 over 30s, sustain 120 for 90s, ramp down 30s. Token mix: 60% short (<100), 30% mid (100-300), 10% long (>300).

sam-telemetry: Noted. Can you also attach the client-side retry logic (backoff), and whether you used streaming? That changes load pattern. Also add the exact request IDs and any server logs you have.

jess-customer: No streaming. Retries: exponential with base 200ms up to 3 retries. I pulled a server-side stacktrace for 9f7a3d11: ```
ERROR [runtime] evict_kv_cache failed: OOM
stack: ...
```

mira.eng: OOM on KV cache suggests large context combined with batching. For the repro-pack we'll try: (a) same promptset at 120 rps, (b) reduced batch size, (c) pinned model variant low-vram. Can you run one curl with explicit header to force small batch: ```
-H "X-Redwood-Batch-Max: 1"
```

jess-customer: Running now. Curl with X-Redwood-Batch-Max:1 seems stable for a minute, no 500s yet. I'll collect the trace IDs and upload the debug bundle.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rolling restart of us-east serving pool at 2024-11-02T18:12:33Z — might overlap with customer's experiments.

alex.support: Good catch — we'll coordinate. Mira, Sam: can you produce a repro-pack zip with promptset, concurrency script (wrk2 or vegeta), token counts, three failing request IDs, and the debug bundle from the customer? Tag it: repro/1765067890-jess-cust.zip

mira.eng: On it. I'll include system metrics (GPU mem, CPU, net) and an experiment where we force KV cache disabled to see impact.

jess-customer: Uploading debug bundle now: https://uploads.example.com/debug/1765067890-debug.tar.gz

sam-telemetry: Received. I'll run the repro in a staging pool and post results.

alex.support: Thanks everyone — keeping thread updated. :thumbsup:
